figurative_meaning_en: to become crooked or bent (figuratively, to deviate or yield)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সিদ্ধান্ত বাঁকা হয়ে গেল চাপের মুখে।
example_sentences_in_english: His resolve became crooked under pressure.
history: References Rabindranath Tagore's line: 'শ্রীমতীরে হেরি বাঁকি গেল রেখা', from his poetic works, symbolizing bending in defeat or deviation in emotion.
note: Primarily literary usage from Tagore's influence in Bengali culture.
